mapper.sql: BETWEEN (CAST(#{year} AS text)||'01') AND (CAST(#{year} AS text)||'12')
mapper.select: SELECT PL_YM AS "month",SALES_AMT AS "revenue",ALLOC_COST_AMT AS "allocatedCost",IDLE_COST_AMT AS "idleCost", DRCT_EXPS_AMT AS "directExpense",SALES_COST_AMT AS "costOfSales",GROSS_PRFT_AMT AS "grossProfit", SGA_TOT_AMT AS "sga",PREV_ADJ_AMT AS "previousAdjustment",OPRT_PRFT_AMT AS "operatingProfit", NOPR_INCM_AMT AS "income",NOPR_EXPS_AMT AS "expense",CORP_TAX_AMT AS "tax",NET_PRFT_AMT AS "netProfit", MIGR_YN AS "migrated",FIX_YN AS "fixed",MOD_DTTM AS "modifiedAt", SGA_INPUT_AMT AS "sellingAdministrativeInput",INDRCT_LABOR_AMT AS "indirectLaborCost",RND_AMT AS "internalResearchCost" FROM TB_CO_MON_PL WHERE PL_YM ORDER BY PL_YM

WITH months AS (SELECT to_char(m,'YYYYMM') AS ym,m::date AS first_day,(m+interval '1 month')::date AS next_day FROM generate_series(make_date(#{year},1,1),make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1),interval '1 month') m) SELECT m.ym AS "month",p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractType", COALESCE(t.CODE_NM,p.CTRT_TYPE_CD) AS "contractName",p.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "clientId", COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,'미지정') AS "clientName",h.PART_ID AS "partId",COALESCE(s.PART_NM,'미지정') AS "partName", p.CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount",p.BDGT_AMT AS "budget",b.amount AS "billed",e.amount AS "directExpense",d.amount AS "distribution" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE t ON t.CODE_GRP_ID='CTRT_TYPE' AND t.CODE=p.CTRT_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.PART_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND x.APLY_BGN_YM <= m.ym ORDER BY x.APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true LEFT JOIN TB_BS_PART s ON s.PART_ID=h.PART_ID LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.SPLY_AMT) AS amount FROM TB_BL_BILL x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND x.BILL_DT >= m.first_day AND x.BILL_DT < m.next_day AND x.CNCL_YN='N') b ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.EXPS_AMT) AS amount FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND x.EXPS_YM=m.ym) e ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.DSTRB_AMT) AS amount FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND x.DSTRB_YM=m.ym AND x.ROW_TYPE_CD='DEV' AND x.DSTRB_STEP_CD=(SELECT z.DSTRB_STEP_CD FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB z JOIN TB_SY_CODE k ON k.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND k.CODE=z.DSTRB_STEP_CD WHERE z.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID ORDER BY CASE k.CODE_NM WHEN '실제 투입계획' THEN 3 WHEN '최종 계약' THEN 2 WHEN '견적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,z.DSTRB_STEP_CD LIMIT 1)) d ON true ORDER BY m.ym,p.PROJ_ID

SELECT COST_YM AS "month",PROJ_ID AS "projectId",COST_CLS_CD AS "classification",SALES_AMT AS "revenue", LABOR_ALLOC_AMT AS "labor",TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team",PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense",DRCT_EXPS_AMT AS "directExpense" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST WHERE COST_YM AND FIX_YN='Y' ORDER BY COST_YM,DEV_ID,PROJ_ID,ASGN_ID

SELECT FIN_YM AS "month",FIN_CLS_CD AS "category",sum(AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_FI_ITEM WHERE FIN_YM GROUP BY FIN_YM,FIN_CLS_CD UNION ALL SELECT APLY_YM,'ADJUSTMENT',sum(ADJ_AMT) FROM TB_CO_PREV_ADJ WHERE APLY_YM GROUP BY APLY_YM
SELECT EST_TAX_AMT FROM TB_FI_CORP_TAX WHERE TAX_YR=#{year}

SELECT h.DEV_ID AS "developerId",h.DEV_NM AS "developerName",h.BLNG_CLNT_ID AS "affiliationId",'' AS "affiliationName", h.JBPS_CD AS "positionCode",'' AS "positionName",h.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode",'' AS "employeeTypeName", h.JNCMP_DT AS "joinDate",h.RETIRE_DT AS "retireDate",h.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",'' AS "jobName", h.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",'' AS "gradeName",h.PART_ID AS "salesPartId",h.DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClassCode", h.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber",'' AS "salesPartName" FROM TB_HR_DEV h ORDER BY h.DEV_ID

SELECT p.PAY_YM AS "yearMonth",p.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", p.PAY_AMT AS "salary",p.ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance",p.INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", p.RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve",p.INSR_SELF_AMT AS "personalInsurance",p.WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax", p.INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax",p.REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay",p.VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY p WHERE p.PAY_YM
SELECT PAY_YM AS "month",DEV_ID AS "developerId",DRCT_CLS_CD AS "classification" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY WHERE PAY_YM

SELECT DEV_ID AS "developerId",BGN_DT AS "startDate",END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT WHERE WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND BGN_DT < make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1)+interval '1 month' AND (END_DT IS NULL OR END_DT >= make_date(#{year},1,1))
SELECT CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupCode",CODE AS "code",CODE_NM AS "name",CODE_VAL AS "value" FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N'

WITH months AS (SELECT to_char(m,'YYYYMM') AS ym,m::date AS first_day,(m+interval '1 month'-interval '1 day')::date AS last_day FROM generate_series(make_date(#{year},1,1),make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1),interval '1 month') m), inputs AS ( SELECT a.*,m.ym, COALESCE(n.MON_MM,round(COALESCE(h.mm,a.CTRT_MM)*(LEAST(a.INPUT_END_DT,m.last_day)-GREATEST(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,m.first_day)+1)/extract(day from m.last_day),2)) AS mm, COALESCE(n.SALES_AMT,trunc(COALESCE(h.price,a.BILL_UPRC,0)*round(COALESCE(h.mm,a.CTRT_MM)* (LEAST(a.INPUT_END_DT,m.last_day)-GREATEST(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,m.first_day)+1)/extract(day from m.last_day),2))) AS revenue FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN months m ON a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= m.last_day AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= m.first_day LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON n ON n.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND n.INPUT_YM=m.ym LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT x.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= m.last_day AND x.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS mm, (SELECT x.NEW_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= m.last_day AND x.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS price) h ON true WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL') SELECT a.ym AS "yearMonth",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",'' AS "jobName",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode", a.mm AS "mm",a.revenue AS "revenue",p.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team",p.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense", p.CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount",p.BDGT_AMT AS "budget",NULL::numeric AS "distribution" FROM inputs a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID WHERE a.mm > 0 ORDER BY a.ym,a.DEV_ID,a.PROJ_ID,a.ASGN_ID
